verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms llms.txt answers HTTP 200 at docs.ultrametric.ai/llms.txt and indexes markdown doc pages (every docs URL is served as .md). The CLI's `init` also writes agent skill files (SKILL.md) for Codex and Claude Code, which a keyless dry-run probe verified, so agents get agent-oriented instructions directly. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of the llms.txt and agent-docs experience, and a working OpenAPI contract link (the documented /contracts/openapi.json path 404s), so not every docs-referenced machine-readable artifact resolves.
